units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Did you know, Professor? Those stars I pointed out to you most likely died out many, many years ago.</color>
units.displayText: Did you know, Professor? Those stars I pointed out to you most likely died out many, many years ago.

spans.text: Did you know, Professor? Those stars I pointed out to you most likely died out many, many years ago.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>What we see is but... the remnant light of a now extinct mass. Hmm—you think it's unfortunate? I think it's mesmerizing...</color>
units.displayText: What we see is but... the remnant light of a now extinct mass. Hmm—you think it's unfortunate? I think it's mesmerizing...

spans.text: What we see is but... the remnant light of a now extinct mass. Hmm—you think it's unfortunate? I think it's mesmerizing...

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>each and every star advances towards annihilation, and every beam of light has its end. How are you to know, then, that I am not the remnants of something already dead?</color>
units.displayText: each and every star advances towards annihilation, and every beam of light has its end. How are you to know, then, that I am not the remnants of something already dead?

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Hehe... seems I've made you worry again. Fret not, I am still here... at least for now.</color>
